name: Long Beach
summary: West-coast beach: swim and walk about 20 km of sand, then stay for sunset over the Gulf. The sand is yellow and gently sloping, and the water is clear enough to see the seaweed. Sunrise and sunset are both here, with swimming, food, cocktails, and live music. Give the beach the day.
getThere: On the southwest shore if the room faces the sand
bestMonths: November–April, and lunar month 11 to lunar month 4
heroCaption: Storm light on Bãi Trường, with the palms and the shore building
body: Swim, walk, and eat on Bãi Trường, then stay for the sun going down over the Gulf. The beach runs along the southwest shore, about 20 km from Mũi Dinh Cậu to Khóe Tàu Rũ, a gently sloping yellow sand and clear green water in which you can see the seaweed. The shore is for sunbathing, water activities, music, food, cocktails, live music, DJs, and fire shows, and for watching the sun set over the ocean. It is the heart of the island’s social life.

In storm light the shore is grey surf, tan sand, palms, a thatched shade, and a low building. That is the daytime weather. The sunset is a later hour on the same sand. Bãi Sao is the southeast swim, about 25 minutes or about 25 km from Dương Đông. Keep the sunset on this beach.

figures.caption: Rocky shallows on Bãi Trường, with clear water over the sand
figures.alt: Dark rocks in clear shallow water on Long Beach, Phu Quoc

gettingThere: Bãi Trường runs about 20 km along the southwest shore, from Mũi Dinh Cậu to Khóe Tàu Rũ. Stay on it when the room faces the sand. Phu Quoc International Airport is in Duong To, and Sun Group has operated it since 1 January 2026.

legs.heading: From Dương Đông
legs.body: The beach starts at Mũi Dinh Cậu, on the town shore. Dinh Cậu is the temple at that north end, for the late afternoon.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: Phu Quoc International Airport is in Duong To. Sun Group has operated it since 1 January 2026. A motorbike, a taxi, a minibus, or a coach is the ride onto the island.
